diagram.content: flowchart TD; subgraph Initialization; A --> B(generate_kpoints: Create IBZ k-point mesh and weights); B --> C(distribute_kpoints: Assign k-points to MPI pools); C --> D(init_psi_k_random: Generate Random ψ_nk(G) for all k); D --> E(orthogonalize_psi_k: Initial Orthogonalization at each k); end; subgraph SCF_Loop; subgraph Parallel k-point Loop (per pool); E --> F(ifft_psi_k_batch: ψ_nk(G) → ψ_nk(r)); F --> G(sum_orbitals_sq_k_local: Compute ρ_pool(r)); end; G --> H(mpi_allreduce_density_pools: Sum to get ρ_total(r)); subgraph Build Potential V_eff(r); H --> I(fft_density: ρ(r) → ρ(G)); I --> J(calc_hartree_pot_g: V_H(G)); J --> K(ifft_hartree_pot: V_H(G) → V_H(r)); H --> L(calc_xc_pot_r: V_xc(r)); K & L --> M(assemble_potential: V_eff(r) = V_H + V_xc + V_local); end; subgraph Parallel k-point Loop (per pool); subgraph Apply Hamiltonian H_k ψ_nk; M & F --> N(apply_H_realspace_k: V_eff(r) * ψ_nk(r)); N --> O(fft_H_psi_k_batch: Real-space part → G-space); E --> P(apply_H_gspace_k: Add Kinetic Energy T_kψ_nk(G)); E --> Q(apply_nonlocal_pseudo_k: Apply V_NL); O & P & Q --> R(assemble_H_psi_k: H_kψ_nk(G)); end; subgraph Update and Orthogonalize per k; R & E --> S(eigensolver_step_k: Update ψ_nk(G) using H_kψ_nk); S --> T(orthogonalize_psi_k: Enforce Orthonormality at each k); end; end; subgraph Convergence Check and Mixing; T --> U(calc_energy_and_check_convergence: Calculate E_total, check |ΔE|); U -- No --> V(mix_density: ρ_in ← mix(ρ_in, ρ_out)); V --> H; U -- Yes --> W[End]; end; T --> E_loop_end{{Next Iteration}}; E_loop_end --> E; end;
